content.json:
## IB Gateway
Events, metrics and (when you opted in) redacted raw log lines of your gateway containers, shipped by the Vector profile of `brokersre-ib-gateway`. Times are UTC. An empty chart means no row arrived in the selected time range: the state is **not measured**, not healthy. The queries behind every tile are documented in `azure/kql/` of the repository.

parameters.name: Instance
parameters.label: Gateway instance
parameters.query:
IbGwMetrics_CL
| distinct Instance
| sort by Instance asc

content.query:
IbGwMetrics_CL
| where '*' in ({Instance}) or Instance in ({Instance})
| where isnotempty(Phase)
| summarize Samples = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Phase
content.title: Phase timeline (30-second samples per phase)
content.noDataMessage: No metrics row in this time range: the phase is not measured.

content.query:
IbGwMetrics_CL
| where '*' in ({Instance}) or Instance in ({Instance})
| where isnotempty(Phase)
| sort by Instance asc, TimeGenerated asc
| extend NewStretch = Instance != prev(Instance) or BootId != prev(BootId) or Phase != prev(Phase)
| extend Stretch = row_cumsum(toint(NewStretch))
| summarize From = min(TimeGenerated), To = max(TimeGenerated), Samples = count() by Instance, BootId, Phase, Stretch
| project Instance, Phase, From, To, Duration = To - From, BootId
| sort by From desc
| take 200
content.title: Phase stretches (newest first)
content.noDataMessage: No metrics row in this time range.

content.query:
IbGwEvents_CL
| where '*' in ({Instance}) or Instance in ({Instance})
| where Event in ('twofa_initiated', 'login_completed')
| sort by Instance asc, TimeGenerated asc
| extend NewEpisode = Instance != prev(Instance) or prev(Event) == 'login_completed'
| extend Episode = row_cumsum(toint(NewEpisode))
| summarize FirstPrompt = minif(TimeGenerated, Event == 'twofa_initiated'), Prompts = countif(Event == 'twofa_initiated'), Completed = maxif(TimeGenerated, Event == 'login_completed') by Instance, Episode
| where isnotnull(Completed)
| extend SecondsToApprove = iff(isnotnull(FirstPrompt) and Completed >= FirstPrompt, datetime_diff('second', Completed, FirstPrompt), long(null))
| summarize Logins = count(), LoginsWithSecondFactor = countif(isnotnull(SecondsToApprove)), P50SecondsToApprove = percentile(SecondsToApprove, 50), P90SecondsToApprove = percentile(SecondsToApprove, 90), MaxSecondsToApprove = max(SecondsToApprove) by Instance, Week = startofweek(Completed)
| sort by Week desc, Instance asc
content.title: Logins and second-factor approvals per week (time from the first request to the completed login)
content.noDataMessage: No completed login in this time range.

content.query:
IbGwMetrics_CL
| where '*' in ({Instance}) or Instance in ({Instance})
| summarize WorkingSetMiB = avg(MemWorkingSetBytes) / 1048576.0, JavaRssMiB = avg(JavaRssBytes) / 1048576.0, LimitMiB = avg(MemLimitBytes) / 1048576.0 by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Instance
content.title: Memory (MiB): container working set, JVM resident set, container limit
content.noDataMessage: No metrics row in this time range.

content.query:
IbGwMetrics_CL
| where '*' in ({Instance}) or Instance in ({Instance})
| where isnotnull(CpuUsageUsec)
| summarize UsedUsec = max(CpuUsageUsec) - min(CpuUsageUsec), ThrottledUsec = max(CpuThrottledUsec) - min(CpuThrottledUsec), Span = max(TimeGenerated) - min(TimeGenerated) by Instance, BootId, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
| where Span > 0s
| summarize CpuCores = sum(UsedUsec / 1000000.0 / (Span / 1s)), ThrottledCores = sum(ThrottledUsec / 1000000.0 / (Span / 1s)) by TimeGenerated, Instance
content.title: CPU (cores used and cores throttled, from the cumulative counters)
content.noDataMessage: No CPU sample in this time range.

content.query:
IbGwMetrics_CL
| where '*' in ({Instance}) or Instance in ({Instance})
| summarize JavaThreads = max(JavaThreads), OpenFds = max(OpenFds), CloseWaitSockets = max(CloseWaitSockets), Pids = max(Pids) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Instance
content.title: JVM threads, open file descriptors, API sockets in CLOSE_WAIT, processes (maximum per interval)
content.noDataMessage: No metrics row in this time range.

content.query:
union
    (IbGwEvents_CL | project TimeGenerated, Instance, BootId, Event),
    (IbGwMetrics_CL | project TimeGenerated, Instance, BootId, Event = '')
| where '*' in ({Instance}) or Instance in ({Instance})
| summarize Boots = dcount(BootId), OomKillEvents = countif(Event == 'oom_kill') by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), Instance
| sort by TimeGenerated desc, Instance asc
content.title: Container starts and OOM kills per day
content.noDataMessage: No row in this time range.

content.query:
IbGwEvents_CL
| where '*' in ({Instance}) or Instance in ({Instance})
| where Event == 'container_start'
| extend GatewayVersion = tostring(Props.gateway_version), Channel = tostring(Props.channel), IbcVersion = tostring(Props.ibc_version), IbcRelease = tostring(Props.ibc_release), TradingMode = tostring(Props.trading_mode)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Starts = count() by Instance, GatewayVersion, Channel, IbcVersion, IbcRelease, TradingMode
| sort by LastSeen desc
content.title: Gateway and IBC versions over time (from the container_start events)
content.noDataMessage: No container_start event in this time range.

content.query:
IbGwEvents_CL
| where '*' in ({Instance}) or Instance in ({Instance})
| where Event in ('config_rendered', 'config_custom')
| extend ConfigHash = tostring(Props.config_hash), TradingMode = tostring(Props.trading_mode), ReadOnlyApi = tostring(Props.read_only_api), AutoRestartTime = tostring(Props.auto_restart_time), TimeZone = tostring(Props.time_zone)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Starts = count() by Instance, ConfigHash, Event, TradingMode, ReadOnlyApi, AutoRestartTime, TimeZone
| sort by FirstSeen desc
content.title: Configuration changes (a new config_hash means the non-secret configuration changed)
content.noDataMessage: No config_rendered or config_custom event in this time range.

content.query:
IbGwEvents_CL
| where '*' in ({Instance}) or Instance in ({Instance})
| where Level in ('warn', 'error')
| project TimeGenerated, Instance, Level, Src, Event, Msg
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Latest warnings and errors
content.noDataMessage: No warning or error event in this time range.

content.query:
IBGatewayLogs_CL
| where '*' in ({Instance}) or Instance in ({Instance})
| project TimeGenerated, Instance, Level, Code, FilePath, Truncated, RawData
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 200
content.title: Latest raw IBC and launcher lines (redacted; only when raw-log shipping is switched on)
content.noDataMessage: No raw line in this time range. Raw logs are shipped only after you opted in (IBGW_REDACT_USERNAME_FILE or SHIP_RAW_LOGS=yes).
